artifacts.summary: Ten-phase plan extending the Lean appendix to the semantic layer, a derived theorem and its semantic counterpart, derivations as data, the metalogic result map, the decision procedure, and a generator-derived project overview, with a standing four-gate per-phase check.

notes: Phases 1 and 8 are independent (wave 1); phases 2-7 and 9 are serialized because they edit typst/chapters/ax-lean-appendix.typ in document order. Phase 8 is the only atomic-batch phase (generator plus sync-check plus regenerated status.typ). The appendix file carries a pre-existing uncommitted delta that this task extends and must never be reverted.
